test_note: Full suite passes in a single pytest invocation (~15s on a modern laptop). The v5.3.0 'PASS_IN_BOUNDED_BATCHES' claim was not reproducible and has been corrected.

policy_qualification.note: Deterministic after the v5.3.1 seed-before-network-init fix. The v5.3.0 report's 86.7% was one nondeterministic draw (observed range 86.7%-100%).

baseline_comparison.note: First baseline comparison for this project. Learned executive beats random and spectral-heuristic in-distribution but loses to the spectral heuristic on held-out diagnosis accuracy.

torch_compile.architecture: fixed-shape sparse numerical kernels; eager discrete evolution
torch_compile.note: The compiled kernel architecture is inherited from v5.2; no new v5.3 Inductor performance claim is made because this container exceeded the compile window.
